claims.statement: Under the declared exploratory-v1 STNFS heuristics (H1, H2, H3, H4, H5, H-EA, H-ECM, H-R, H-SM, H-X, H-FFT) and the abstract flat-RAM scalar ARMv8.1-A + disclosed FEAT_LSE STADDB/STADD cost model, BLS12-381 G_1 ECDLP with auxiliary powers (bls12-381-g1-ecdlp: given 1 <= n < r, A_i = [s^i mod r] P_0 for 1 <= i <= n, and T = [s] P_0 = A_1 with uniform s in 1..r-1; scored at n = 1048576 = 2^20; ignoring all higher auxiliary powers A_2..A_n so W_G1(n) = W_cold holds identically for every 1 <= n < r) is solved via pairing transfer (g = e(P_0, Q_0), z_T = e(T, Q_0)) and two calibrated gamma_0-blinded G_T virtual logarithms with cold-run success probability >= 0.39 (post-headroom floor p_floor = 0.9999, K_gate = 7194949683715096640) in gated expected cost E[W_G1(n)] <= 2^110.11311840 < 2^110.113119 G_1-reference units (log2 bound 110.113119 = 110113119/1000000 at n = 1048576, where C_G1 = 2,000 Ir/u = 10x dense-F_{p^12} core units at C = 20,000 Ir/u; core E[W_run] <= 2^108.1495 core units, core E[W] < 2^106.791500 core units, hard pointwise meter W_G1(n) <= 10*(2^124 + 2^66) < 2^127.321929 G_1 units for all 1 <= n < r). No prior verdict or score is a premise.
